channel.title: Lectures on OpenEMR
channel.description: Recent content in Lectures on OpenEMR

item.title: Medical Billing Clearinghouse and Eligibility Verification in OpenEMR
item.description: Brad Sharp demonstrates the ClaimRev Clearinghouse Module, which is an easy to use OpenEMR Module that supports Medical Billing Clearinghouse and Eligibility Verification.

item.title: First Impressions Are Everything: Creating an Inviting OpenEMR Login Page for your Users
item.description: Robert Down discusses how to customize the OpenEMR login page.

item.title: Twig, Macros, and Partials: Streamline your OpenEMR Development
item.description: Robert Down discusses how to streamline your OpenEMR developement with twig, macros, and partials.

item.title: C-CDA and OpenEMR - Everything you need to know
item.description: Jerry Padgett discusses everything you need to know about C-CDA (Consolidated Clinical Document Architecture) for OpenEMR.

item.title: VisualEHR (VEHR) Timeline Based Dashboard Module in OpenEMR
item.description: Omega Systems Group describes and demonstrates a timeline based dashboard module in OpenEMR that they are nearing completion on.

item.title: OpenEMR Form Builder: New Feature - Quick and Easy Form Builder
item.description: Jerry Padgett describes a new quick and easy form builder for your questionnaires/assessments that can be used for both encounter forms and patient portal forms. This new feature allows quick use of already existent standardized LOINC forms in addition to forms built via the NLM Form Builder. Because of the poor audio in this video, a chat is also included which transcribes the video.

item.title: Customizing OpenEMR For Your Practice Using Layout Based Forms
item.description: Learn how to customize OpenEMR for your practice using Layout Based Forms in this lecture and demonstration by Sandra Gutierrez. Sandra has experience in using Layout Based Forms in her own practice.

item.title: Acute Care Clinical Workflow
item.description: Learn about the daily workflow of acute care clinical staff in this lecture by Robert Down, who currently works as a travel nurse. Robert has experience in direct-patient care and leadership of nursing units.

item.title: OpenEMR Patient Portal Presentation: New Features - Patient Form Templates Management
item.description: Jerry Padgett describes new features in Patient Portal, which include patient form templates management. Overview on creating and managing patient form templates and distributing them with Template Profiles and Patient Groups.

item.title: OpenEMR FHIR Lecture Series: Lecture 2 - FHIR Bulk Data in OpenEMR
item.description: Stephen Nielson describes OpenEMR’s FHIR Bulk Data API

item.title: OpenEMR FHIR Lecture Series: Lecture 1 - Overview and Use of FHIR in OpenEMR
OpenEMR Modules
item.description: Stephen Nielson describes how to effectively develop OpenEMR modules

item.title: Event Driven Architecture
item.description: Robert Down discusses Event Listeners and how to leverage Event Listeners in OpenEMR development
